descriptionHtml:
Decision D4 · P0 · Vikram

Extraction rules vs UAT: should conditional and monitoring orders create tasks (UAT and TFA-92592 AC3 say yes, the prompt excludes them); should 'continue X' create a tracker row; the ported prompt lost 'continue X is a status, not a task'; Nursing Home dictation uses the Hospital vocabulary hint

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-22/S07, TC-19/S20, TC-22/S25

Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S23 TFA-94229 reference files: the vocabulary hint against the prototype, and EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md against the TC-23 grading

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T7 The dictation vocabulary prompt is ported from the prototype as written, unless Vikram approved a change. (TFA-94229 AC 1; TFA-94229 R1; TFA-94229 R2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress
  • T5 TC-23 passes as a UAT AI check per ground rule 3.2, graded against Vikram's EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md. (TFA-94229 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given DEFAULT_MEDICAL_HINT in convex/ai/transcribe.ts (marked 'source :4765'); prototype files RoundCompanion_aug21b and RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU; 'EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK (1).md' posted by Daniela on 2026-10-13 (all TFA-94229 attachments; no copy under roundai/ or tools/qa-agent yet)

When (1) Compare the hint word for word with the prototype at that line; list which surfaces and contexts get it; check whether the planned per-surface vocabulary prompts exist. (2) Once Quinn has saved a read-only copy of EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md under tools/qa-agent/uat/, map every transcription or dictation criterion in …

Then (1) The hint matches the prototype exactly, or Vikram's approval of the difference is on record. (2) Every criterion in the framework that applies to TC-23 maps onto an S01/S02 check and every difference is listed; if the file has no dictation rubric, T5 stays without an oracle until Q14 is answered

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Side-by-side review against TFA-94229 AC 1, R1, R2 (T7) and AC 2 (T5); each difference listed. Hospital-only vocabulary used in Nursing Home is Q9; whether the framework grades TC-23 is Q14

UAT item: TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-23/S23

TFA-94229 reference files: the vocabulary hint against the prototype, and EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md against the TC-23 grading

Tickets: TFA-94229 Port & preserve Vikram's clinical AI logic (in progress)

New local lane code-review: status partial in code-review/results.json → needs a person (partial: the half that can be checked passed, the other half needs another lane / a person / a file → a person looks).

Detail:

Part (1) passes. DEFAULT_MEDICAL_HINT (apps/web/convex/ai/transcribe.ts:41) is word for word the same as the Whisper prompt string in both prototypes. I ran an exact-string search with the full text, ending at the closing quote, and it found one match in RoundCompanion_aug21b.html (line 6281, formData.append('prompt', ...)) and one in RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (line 7085). The scripted parity check agrees (verbatim against both). The only thing that differs is the "source :4765" pointer in the code comment: the string sits at line 6281/7085 in these prototype files, not 4765. That is a comment and does not change the hint.

Where the hint goes:
- **Live path:** prepareSession always sends DEFAULT_MEDICAL_HINT in the realtime transcription session.
- **Batch and recovery path:** transcribeAudio sends args.medicalHint || DEFAULT_MEDICAL_HINT. No client call passes medicalHint, so every caller gets the same hospital-oriented hint. The callers are:
  - Hospital rounding: AddPatient, quick dictation, PreRoundTab, encounter capture, encounter tasks.
  - Clinic: PreVisitTab, EncounterTab.
  - Nursing Home (SNF): PreRoundTab, encounter dictation.
  - The Ask modal.

There are no per-surface vocabulary prompts. Whether the hospital vocabulary is right for Nursing Home is Q9 and is outside this verdict. Part (2) waits on the EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md copy, which is not under tools/qa-agent/uat/ at this commit.

Missing document (needsDoc): Part 2: EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK (1).md (TFA-94229 attachment, posted by Daniela 2026-10-13) saved read-only under tools/qa-agent/uat/; Part 1 is the code review above.

Open questions (openQuestions):

  • The comment's 'source :4765' line does not match where the string sits in the handoff prototype files (6281 in aug21b, 7085 in p72). It may refer to another prototype version; it does not affect the text match.
  • Q9: one hospital-oriented hint is used on every surface, including Nursing Home and Clinic, and there are no per-surface vocabulary prompts. Whether that is acceptable is outside this verdict.
  • Q9: every surface, including Nursing Home and Clinic, gets the same hospital/pneumonia-oriented vocabulary hint, and no per-surface vocabulary prompts exist. Whether that is acceptable is for Q9.
  • Q14 / Part 2: whether EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md has a dictation rubric that grades TC-23 cannot be judged until a copy is saved under tools/qa-agent/uat/.

Not decidable from the code (notDecidableByCode):

  • Part 2 (DOC (EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md not saved under tools/qa-agent/uat/))
  • Part 2: mapping EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md criteria onto the S01/S02 checks needs the saved copy under tools/qa-agent/uat/, which is not at this commit; if the file has no dictation rubric, it also waits on Q14.
  • Whether Vikram approved any planned per-surface vocabulary prompts (none exist in code).
  • Part 2: mapping EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md criteria (numbers, boundaries, occurrences, drug names, units, the 9/10 bar) onto the S01/S02 checks is a document task, and the file is not in the repository.
  • Whether Vikram approved any change is not needed, because no difference was found.

Review verdict (verdict): pass

Evidence: 2 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: outside-runner (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
